in_hebrew.name: Di
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Di הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Di was a goddess of justice and a judge of the underworld. In Christianity, the name Di may symbolize being a judge of one's own actions and living a righteous life.
